original_prompt: create a pretty calculator app in python and flask
description: A Flask single-page calculator: a safe AST-based arithmetic engine behind a /calculate JSON API, with an HTML/CSS/JS UI.

spec.description: A Flask single-page calculator: a safe AST-based arithmetic engine behind a /calculate JSON API, with an HTML/CSS/JS UI.

components.name: Calculator

attributes.description: AST node types permitted during the safety walk.

methods.description: Parse, safety-check, and evaluate an arithmetic expression; raises ValueError on invalid/unsafe input.

notes: Rejects any AST node outside the whitelist (no function calls, names, etc.).
